title: It Started With Two People
text:
It Started With Two People
CGI AT 50
QUÉBEC CITY, JUNE 1976
Serge Godin started the company in Québec City. Within months he was joined by André Imbeau. Two people, no clients, and a written-down idea of what the place should feel like to work in.
 
The name is French: 
Conseillers en gestion et informatique
 — management and information systems consultants, or in English, 
Consultants to Government and Industry.
 
Fifty years later, the name still describes the job exactly.
THE CGI DREAM
“To create an environment in which we enjoy working together and, as owners, contribute to building a company we can be proud of.”
Written in CGI's first decade and never rewritten. It sits at the top of the CGI Constitution — Dream, Vision, Mission, Values.

title: Five Decades Of Building
text:
Five Decades Of Building
CGI AT 50
1976 – 1985
Building The Dream
Founded in Québec City. The CGI Constitution is written — Dream, Vision, Mission, Values.
1986 – 1995
Laying The Foundation
IPO in 1986 at $6.50 a share. First North American IT consultancy to earn ISO 9001.
1996 – 2005
Build And Buy
Bell Sygma, IMRglobal and AMS. Revenue reaches $3.5B by 2006.
2006 – 2015
Global Integration
Stanley Inc. and Logica take the company to 68,000 people across three continents.
2016 – 2026
Innovation And AI
BJSS, Daugherty, Novatec. A $1B commitment to AI capability. 94,000 Partners today.

title: We Are Not Employees. We Are Owners.
text:
We Are Not Employees. We Are Owners.
CGI AT 50
CGI Partners
Everyone who joins is invited to become a shareholder from day one. That is why the people here are called Partners rather than employees.
 
The practical effect: a Partner deciding how to handle a client problem is deciding it with their own money on the table.
 
Three stakeholders, held in balance: clients, Partners, shareholders.
THE CGI CONSTITUTION
DREAM
Enjoy working together and, as owners, build a company we can be proud of.
VISION
To be a world-class IT and business process services leader.
MISSION
Help our clients succeed through quality, competence and objectivity.
VALUES
Partnership and quality. Objectivity and integrity. Respect. Financial strength. Corporate social responsibility.

Northwind Utilities

title: The Brief They Sent You
text:
The Brief They Sent You
CGI AT 50
“Our complaint handling process is too slow. We want an AI-powered solution that automates complaint triage and response so we can clear the backlog and get our regulator score back above 4.0 within twelve months.”
That is the brief. Whether it is the right brief is your first job.
Anything can be the answer.   
You are not being asked to build what the client asked for. You are being asked to solve their problem. It might be AI. It might be a process, a pricing change, a piece of infrastructure, or telling them their twelve-month target is not achievable. No option is off the table and none is pre-approved.

title: What You Deliver
text:
What You Deliver
CGI AT 50
DIAGNOSE
DESIGN
BUILD
PITCH
The Pitch
Ten minutes to the judges, plus five minutes of questions. Pitch as if we are the Northwind executive committee. Every member of your team speaks.
The Build
Something that actually runs, demoed live. Data, AI, a prototype, an integration, a service redesign — your call. Slides are optional. A demo is not.
The Value Case
One page. What it costs, what it saves, over what period, and what you are assuming. Declared estimates beat confident numbers with no working.
